FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A61
For one through five miles per hour over the limit, the printed fine table lists ten dollars normally and twenty dollars in its qualifying work/school-zone column, plus court costs. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A61
For six through ten miles per hour over the limit, the printed table lists twenty-five dollars normally and fifty dollars for qualifying work/school zones, plus court costs. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A61
For eleven through fifteen miles per hour over, the printed amounts are seventy-five dollars normally and one hundred fifty for qualifying work/school zones, plus court costs. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A61
For sixteen through twenty miles per hour over, the printed amounts are one hundred twenty-five dollars normally and two hundred fifty for qualifying work/school zones, plus court costs. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A61
For twenty-one through thirty-five miles per hour over, the printed amounts are two hundred dollars normally and four hundred for qualifying work/school zones, plus court costs. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A61
Above thirty-five miles per hour over, the printed table lists three hundred dollars normally and six hundred for qualifying work/school zones, plus court costs. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A61
The work-zone doubled-fine qualification requires workers to be present; the table also applies to school zones. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A61
Passing inside a marked no-passing zone is unlawful. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A61
A driver may not exceed the posted speed limit to pass another vehicle. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A61
Do not pass a school bus while its red lights flash and its stop arm is extended. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R11 | anchor: A61
Passing is prohibited within one hundred feet of an intersection or railroad crossing. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R12 | anchor: A61
Do not pass on a hill, curve or bridge when the view is obstructed. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R13 | anchor: A61
Before passing, decide whether it is necessary and remain at least three seconds behind the vehicle ahead. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R14 | anchor: A61
Before moving into the passing lane, signal and check around the vehicle. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R15 | anchor: A61
The passing sequence increases speed and moves into the passing lane while the separately stated posted-speed cap still applies. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R16 | anchor: A61
Signal and return right when the passed vehicle's front or headlights can be seen in the rearview mirror, then resume travelling speed. [A61]
Source: [A61 -> pdf-0061]
